state.runtime_observation_retention: First63 plus latest when more than64; every observation still gates execution

actor_exit.reason: Keep verified main live for original authenticated boundary.close; not an actor success exit claim

last_live_properties.affinity_scope: Observed main-thread affinity only; no delegated cpuset prevention of later widening or all-thread lifetime claim

CUDA.guard_scope: Guard starts after Torch import; that interval and unwrapped native calls are not monitored. Real is_available/device_count queries require False/0; own operations are CPU.

actor_receipt.cache_state: Selected-range prehash prefaults/warms pages. No cold latency claim or cache eviction. OS page-level read-ahead may touch adjacent bytes; only explicit application range requests are restricted.
actor_receipt.limits: Mapped native single-layer synthetic CPU determinism only; no clone-equivalence,GPU,UMA,12B,8192,20s,N3,Q95,browser or score qualification

real_layer_microbenchmark_scope: CPU single-layer selected weights only; no full12B,8192context,20s,GPU,N3,Q95 or model-quality qualification
